title: Live site activity
responsibility: Keeps a supplied project activity snapshot visible while refreshing its live observations.

inputs.name: SiteActivity.shown
inputs.description: Required initial recorded and live activity snapshot. Remains visible until a newer read arrives.

outputs.name: SiteActivity
outputs.description: Project activity for the most recent successful read, with reading age, failure state and refresh control. On mount starts the activity client and a five-second age clock; on destruction stops both. A failed refresh retains prior data and marks the read as failed.
